title: Orange & Poppyseed Friands
description: Fluffy little citrus pillows that taste like sunshine — and maybe just a bit of smug satisfaction.

method.instruction: Preheat oven to 180°C fan-forced. Grease a 12-hole friand tin thoroughly.
In a large bowl, combine icing sugar, almond meal, flour, poppy seeds, and orange zest.
In a separate bowl, whisk egg whites until just frothy — do not whip to stiff peaks.
Add cooled melted butter, vanilla extract, and orange juice to the egg whites. Stir gently.
Fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until just combined. Do not overmix.
Pour batter into a 2-litre jug for easy pouring, then fill each friand tin about three-quarters full.
Bake for 20–25 minutes until golden and domed.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely.

notes.title: Egg Whites
notes.content: Only whisk the egg whites until frothy — just enough to break them up. Stiff peaks will make the friands tough and chewy rather than light and tender.

notes.title: The Jug Method
notes.content: Pouring the batter into a jug before filling the tins gives you perfect control and minimises mess. It is a small step that makes a big difference.
